The '''Republic crystal refinery''' was established by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum]] to process the [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]] it was raided by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|forces]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic crystal refinery appears as an area on Ilum in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
